steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be configured.
Add one CYLINDER line item with the requested quantity.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet fields required for publication.
Invite one QA vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Publish the RFQ before placing a bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the invited vendor place a bid, establishing the post-bid state.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.

args.goal: on the buyer's live multi-currency RFQ with the bid present, open the exchange-rate editor, attempt to change the exchange rate, and stop when the screen shows the refusal 'Exchange rates cannot be updated after bids have been placed.'

steps.note: Perform the exchange-rate edit that has no dedicated catalog step and leave the refusal visible.
